subject: general
question:
From the alternatives given below, select the correct meaning of the idiom.
To have a finger in every pie.

options.text: To be involved in a situation, often in a meddlesome way
To be involved in several different activities or enterprises at once, especially when maintaining some level of influence over those activities
Regardless of how a situation is analyzed, viewed, or portrayed, the truth of it remains unchanged
To have a portion of the money or profits that are being shared by everyone involved in generating them

solution:
The correct answer is: **2 i.e. To be involved in several different activities or enterprises at once, especially when maintaining some level of influence over those activities.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"To have a finger in every pie"** means being involved in many different activities or enterprises at the same time, often with some level of control or influence. (कई गतिविधियों या उद्यमों में शामिल होना, अक्सर कुछ हद तक नियंत्रण या प्रभाव के साथ)
 
 
• **Example:** She has a finger in every pie, from running her business to volunteering for social causes.
 

Hence, the meaning of the idiom aligns with option **2**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **2 i.e. To be involved in several different activities or enterprises at once, especially when maintaining some level of influence over those activities.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

__
 
• **Option 1: To be involved in a situation, often in a meddlesome way** (किसी स्थिति में शामिल होना, अक्सर दखल देने वाले तरीके से)
 
 
• **Example:** He always tries to have a finger in every pie, even when nobody asks for his help.
 
 

 
• **Option 3: Regardless of how a situation is analyzed, viewed, or portrayed, the truth of it remains unchanged** (इससे कोई फर्क नहीं पड़ता कि स्थिति का विश्लेषण, दृष्टिकोण, या चित्रण कैसे किया जाता है, इसकी सच्चाई अपरिवर्तित रहती है)
 
 
• **Example:** This phrase does not fit the idiom's meaning.
 
 

 
• **Option 4: To have a portion of the money or profits that are being shared by everyone involved in generating them** (पैसे या लाभ का हिस्सा रखना जो सभी द्वारा साझा किया जा रहा हो)
 
 
• **Example:** This interpretation does not fully match the idiom's actual meaning.
